subject: Error in asMethod(object) : negative length vectors are not allowed

messages.author: f61c71ce93912f60
messages.subject: Error in asMethod(object) : negative length vectors are not allowed
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to run a glmmTMB model on a fairly large dataset (302400 rows x 4 columns). The code works well when I run it only using the first (or last) 200000 rows of data. However, when I include the whole dataset I get this error:

Error in asMethod(object) : negative length vectors are not allowed
Calls: glmmTMB ... mkReTrms -> lapply -> FUN -> KhatriRao -> as -> asMethod

I think it is an error related to memory requirements, but I have been also using large-RAM computers and the problem is still the same. Does someone have suggestions on how to optimize the code or how to use parallel processing or other solutions with glmmTMB? I would greatly appreciate any help. 
Below, a reproducible example and the code I am using to run the model. 

Thank you
Fabiola

library("glmmTMB")
library("ff")
y3 <- expand.grid(id=paste("A", seq(1,30,1), sep = ""), time=seq(1,10080,1))
y3$y <- rbinom(nrow(y3),size=1, prob = 0.3)
head(y3)
dim(y3) #302400 rows x 4 columns
y3_ff <- as.ffdf(y3)
rm(list=c("y3"))
mod.TMB <- glmmTMB(y ~ sin(2*pi*time/(24*60)) + cos(2*pi*time/(24*60)) + (1|id) + ar1(as.factor(time) + 0 | id), data=y3_ff, family= binomial(link="probit"), ziformula = ~0)
summary(mod.TMB)
